design: Prioritize role-relevant high-severity skill gaps, adjust urgency using readiness probability, and reduce recommendations for already-verified skills.
ml_status: Not trained ML; deliberately deterministic for hackathon MVP because credible course-completion-to-outcome labels are unavailable.
limitations: Does not estimate causal effect of course completion on placement.
Course catalog is prototype/synthetic and should be replaced by institutional catalog data.
Recommendations should be evaluated using actual completion and outcome history in production.
